metadata.title: Ephemeral / Immutable Server SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining ephemeral and immutable server execution environments with rebuild-only lifecycle semantics.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all Secure-Server Platform trust semantics and enforces strict ephemeral, rebuild-only execution constraints.

system-characteristics.system-description: Ephemeral servers are short-lived, immutable execution environments designed to run workloads without remediation, in-place repair, or long-term trust persistence. Trust is continuously reassessed and revoked through destruction and rebuild.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Server instances are short-lived and replaced rather than repaired.

props.name: execution-trust-tier
props.remarks: Execution trust is transient and expires with instance lifetime.

props.name: attestation-requirement
props.remarks: Attestation is required at admission and instance creation; continuous attestation is optional and context-dependent.

props.name: configuration-drift-policy
props.remarks: Configuration drift is not remediated; detected drift results in trust revocation and instance replacement.

props.name: vulnerability-handling
props.remarks: Vulnerability exposure is handled through image rebuilds and replacement, not in-place patching.

props.name: runtime-response
props.remarks: Runtime anomalies result in instance termination and replacement rather than response or remediation.

props.name: administrative-access-model
props.remarks: Interactive or privileged administrative access to ephemeral servers is not permitted.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Ephemeral servers do not retain persistent state; all data is externalized or discarded on termination.

system-implementation.remarks: Ephemeral Server environments are implemented through immutable images and declarative execution definitions. This SSPP forbids remediation, manual intervention, and long-lived trust. Security posture is maintained by rapid replacement and deterministic lifecycle signaling.

roles.title: Ephemeral Server Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines immutable execution patterns and lifecycle constraints for ephemeral server environments.

roles.title: Ephemeral Server Governance
roles.remarks: Approves image rebuild cadence, trust expiration policies, and exception handling.

roles.title: Ephemeral Server Operations
roles.remarks: Operates ephemeral execution environments through declarative pipelines and instance replacement.

roles.title: Ephemeral Server Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors runtime, posture, and lifecycle signals to validate correct termination and replacement behavior.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through inheritance from Secure-Server patterns and strict lifecycle enforcement. This SSPP does not implement remediation or operational controls directly.
